parameters.query:
with x as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(source_endpoint text, run_tag text, exec_id text, raw_sha256 text, posting_number text, order_id bigint, order_number text, status text, substatus text, cancellation_type text, cancel_reason text, cancel_reason_id int, created_at_utc timestamptz, in_process_at_utc timestamptz, order_date_msk date, line_ordinal int, sku bigint, offer_id text, product_name text, quantity numeric, price numeric, currency text, old_price numeric, payout numeric, commission_amount numeric, cluster_from text, cluster_to text, warehouse_id bigint, warehouse_name text, delivery_type text, city text, is_premium boolean, is_legal boolean, row_sha256 text)),
ins as (insert into raw.fbo_posting_line_obs (source_endpoint, run_id, exec_id, raw_sha256, posting_number, order_id, order_number, status, substatus, cancellation_type, cancel_reason, cancel_reason_id, created_at_utc, in_process_at_utc, order_date_msk, line_ordinal, sku, offer_id, product_name, quantity, price_rub, currency, old_price, payout, commission_amount, cluster_from, cluster_to, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, delivery_type, city, is_premium, is_legal, row_sha256)
  select source_endpoint, run_tag, exec_id, raw_sha256, posting_number, order_id, order_number, status, substatus, cancellation_type, cancel_reason, cancel_reason_id, created_at_utc, in_process_at_utc, order_date_msk, line_ordinal, sku, offer_id, product_name, quantity, price, currency, old_price, payout, commission_amount, cluster_from, cluster_to, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, delivery_type, city, is_premium, is_legal, row_sha256 from x
  where not exists (select 1 from analytics.v_posting_line_current c where c.posting_number=x.posting_number and c.line_ordinal=x.line_ordinal
     and c.status is not distinct from x.status and c.substatus is not distinct from x.substatus and c.cancellation_type is not distinct from x.cancellation_type
     and c.sku=x.sku and c.quantity=x.quantity and c.price_rub is not distinct from x.price and c.payout is not distinct from x.payout
     and c.commission_amount is not distinct from x.commission_amount and c.cluster_from is not distinct from x.cluster_from
     and c.cluster_to is not distinct from x.cluster_to and c.warehouse_id is not distinct from x.warehouse_id)
  on conflict (row_sha256) do nothing returning 1),
r as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) as r(run_tag text, kind text, date_from date, date_to date, requests_n int, http_statuses jsonb, postings_n int, lines_n int, exec_ids text, status text, note text)),
lg as (insert into ops.cluster_load_run (run_tag, kind, date_from, date_to, requests_n, http_statuses, postings_n, lines_n, lines_inserted, exec_ids, status, note)
  select run_tag, kind, date_from, date_to, requests_n, http_statuses, postings_n, lines_n, (select count(*) from ins), exec_ids, status, note from r returning run_tag, lines_inserted, status)
select * from lg
